comment: Bug Hunt v1 supervised: boot a snapshot from systemd-boot (one-shot), verify snapshot mode, return to the normal boot. vars: snap = snapper number, old_pkg / new_pkg = a package version that differs between the snapshot and @. Every reboot needs the local LUKS unlock.

steps.name: normal boot on @, new package
steps.cmd: grep -c workstation.snapshot= /proc/cmdline; findmnt -no FSTYPE,OPTIONS / ; pacman -Q chromium

steps.name: entry, UKI copy, read-only snapshot, default entry
steps.cmd: set -e; e=/boot/loader/entries/workstation-snapshot-{snap}.conf; grep -q 'workstation.snapshot={snap}' $e; u=$(awk '$1=="uki"{print $2}' $e); test -f /boot$u; btrfs property get -ts /.snapshots/{snap}/snapshot ro | grep -q true; grep -E '^default' /boot/loader/loader.conf; bootctl list --no-pager | grep -A2 'default' | head -3; echo PRECHECK-OK

steps.name: set one-shot + reboot
steps.cmd: bootctl set-oneshot workstation-snapshot-{snap}.conf && sleep 1 && systemctl reboot

steps.text: ACTION REQUIRED: unlock LUKS on the test laptop (boot goes straight to the snapshot entry)

steps.name: snapshot mode: cmdline, overlay root, old package
Ly login (password typed via uinput)
steps.cmd: faillock --user medvidec | tail -n +3 | grep -c . | grep -qx 0 || { echo faillock-not-empty; exit 5; }; sleep 5; python3 /home/medvidec/.cache/testctl-uinput.py type-stdin; for i in $(seq 45); do pgrep -x quickshell >/dev/null && break; sleep 2; done; pgrep -xc quickshell

steps.name: snapshot-mode strip + IPC
steps.cmd: . ~/.cache/testctl-henv.sh; sleep 8; qs ipc --any-display call snapshotmode state; hyprctl -j layers | grep -o 'quickshell-snapshotmode-strip' | head -1

steps.name: end session + reboot (default entry)
steps.cmd: sudo -u medvidec bash -c '. ~/.cache/testctl-henv.sh; hyprctl dispatch "hl.dsp.exit()"' ; sleep 6; systemctl reboot

steps.text: ACTION REQUIRED: unlock LUKS on the test laptop (normal boot)

steps.name: normal boot on @, new package
steps.cmd: grep -c workstation.snapshot= /proc/cmdline; findmnt -no FSTYPE,OPTIONS / ; pacman -Q chromium
